_note: The format of tailor.json: one extra PDF aimed at a single job posting. It lives next to private.json (never in the public site) and only `npm run pdf` reads it. It starts from a version (`base`) and can change the headline, summary and skills, and leave out bullets. It can't add anything new: every fact still comes from resume.json. Delete the fields you don't use.
headline: A headline worded for this posting
summary: A summary worded for this posting, using only facts from resume.json.
drop: A bullet copied exactly from resume.json, to leave out of this version
